description_sources.content: Reading Loom is a set of Lexicon definitions for representing books and reading notes in AT Protocol PDS records. Correction from the maintainers: Reading Loom has never operated a hosted reading journal service and has never implemented sharing, search, or an end-user application. Descriptions of it as a reading-sharing service were incorrect from the start. Developers may use these definitions in their own applications.
